title: Coordinatewise Gowers Cauchy–Schwarz inequality
statement: Let $F$ assign a real-valued function on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ to each $s\in\mathbb{F}_2^k$, and fix a coordinate $i\in\{0,\ldots,k-1\}$. The Gowers inner product of $F$ is at most the product of the square roots of the Gowers inner products of the two families obtained by replacing the $i$th coordinate of every index by $0$ and by $1$, respectively.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued family $F$ indexed by $\mathbb{F}_2^k$ and points of $\mathbb{F}_2^n$
